verdict.rationale: An API platform like Sentry could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so the axis applies. However, the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and no evidence item documents a downloadable spec. The llms.txt file is documentation for LLMs, not an API specification, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
